## Functional Specification

Domain: emulator
Summary: A complete CHIP-8 interpreter that accurately emulates the 1970s virtual machine architecture with 35 opcodes, 64x32 monochrome display, 16-key input, and sound timer.

### Requirements (MUST implement)
- Must implement all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with cycle-accurate behavior
- Must support 64x32 pixel monochrome display with XOR drawing
- Must implement 16-key hexadecimal keypad input
- Must implement 60Hz timers for delay and sound
- Must load ROM files up to 3584 bytes (0xE00-0xFFF)
- Must emulate 4096 bytes of RAM with proper memory mapping
- Must implement 16-level stack for subroutine calls
- Must generate buzzer sound when sound timer > 0

### Data Structures
- 16 8-bit registers V0-VF (V0-V15, VF is carry flag)
- 16-bit index register I (0x000-0xFFF)
- 16-bit program counter PC (0x200-0xFFF)
- 8-bit stack pointer SP (0-15)
- 16x16-bit stack array storing return addresses
- 8-bit delay timer decrementing at 60Hz
- 8-bit sound timer decrementing at 60Hz
- 4096 bytes RAM (0x000-0xFFF)
- 64x32 pixel framebuffer (1 bit per pixel)
- 16-bit opcode register
- 16-element Uint8Array for keypad state (0=up, 1=down)

### Components
- **cpu** (complex, ~400 LOC)
  - fetch(): Uint16 - Read 2 bytes from PC via memory.read(), increment PC by 2
  - decode(opcode: Uint16): {instruction: string, args: any[]} - Parse opcode into operation
  - execute(opcode: Uint16): void - Execute decoded instruction
  - step(): boolean - Fetch, decode, execute one instruction, return false on error
  - reset(): void - Reset all registers to initial state
  - getRegister(index: 0-15): Uint8 - Return V register value
  - setRegister(index: 0-15, value: Uint8): void - Set V register with 8-bit wrap
  - getI(): Uint16 - Return index register value
  - setI(value: Uint16): void - Set index register to 12-bit address
  - getPC(): Uint16 - Return program counter
  - REQ: Implement all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with accurate behavior
  - REQ: Handle 16-bit big-endian opcode fetching
  - REQ: Manage program counter, stack, and flow control
  - REQ: Update timers at 60Hz rate
  - REQ: Trigger display redraw on draw instructions
- **memory** (simple, ~50 LOC)
  - read(address: Uint16): Uint8 - Read byte from memory, mask to 12 bits
  - write(address: Uint16, value: Uint8): void - Write byte to memory, mask to 12 bits
  - loadRom(data: Uint8Array): void - Load ROM starting at 0x200
  - reset(): void - Clear RAM and reload font data
  - getSize(): number - Return total memory size (4096)
  - REQ: Provide 4096 bytes of addressable memory
  - REQ: Load ROM data starting at 0x200
  - REQ: Preserve font data in 0x050-0x09F
  - REQ: Prevent writes to ROM area after loading
- **display** (medium, ~100 LOC)
  - drawSprite(x: Uint8, y: Uint8, spriteData: Uint8Array, height: Uint8): Uint8 - Draw sprite, return collision flag
  - clear(): void - Clear entire display to 0
  - getPixel(x: Uint8, y: Uint8): Uint8 - Get pixel value at coordinates
  - setPixel(x: Uint8, y: Uint8, value: Uint8): void - Set pixel value
  - render(): void - Trigger display refresh
  - getWidth(): number - Return display width (64)
  - getHeight(): number - Return display height (32)
  - isDirty(): boolean - Check if display needs redraw
  - REQ: Implement 64x32 pixel monochrome display
  - REQ: Support XOR drawing with collision detection
  - REQ: Provide clear screen functionality
  - REQ: Trigger redraw only when pixels change
- **input** (simple, ~40 LOC)
  - isKeyPressed(key: Uint8): boolean - Check if key is pressed (0-15)
  - waitForKeyPress(): Uint8 - Block until any key pressed, return key code
  - keyPressed(key: Uint8): void - Mark key as pressed
  - keyReleased(key: Uint8): void - Mark key as released
  - reset(): void - Clear all key states
  - REQ: Track state of 16 hexadecimal keys (0-F)
  - REQ: Support key press and release events
  - REQ: Provide blocking wait for key press
- **timers** (simple, ~30 LOC)
  - update(): void - Decrement timers if > 0, trigger sound
  - setDelayTimer(value: Uint8): void - Set CPU delay timer
  - setSoundTimer(value: Uint8): void - Set CPU sound timer
  - getDelayTimer(): Uint8 - Get current delay timer
  - getSoundTimer(): Uint8 - Get current sound timer
  - REQ: Update delay and sound timers at 60Hz
  - REQ: Trigger sound output when sound timer > 0
  - REQ: Provide accurate 60Hz timing
- **sound** (simple, ~40 LOC)
  - setBuzzer(active: boolean): void - Start/stop sound generation
  - isPlaying(): boolean - Check if sound currently active
  - setFrequency(hz: number): void - Set tone frequency
  - setVolume(level: 0-1): void - Set volume level
  - REQ: Generate square wave tone when buzzer active
  - REQ: Support 60Hz timer-based sound generation
  - REQ: Provide start/stop sound control

### Integration Rules (CRITICAL)
- CPU reads memory via memory.read(address), does NOT own RAM array
- CPU writes memory via memory.write(address, value), does NOT own RAM array
- CPU draws via display.drawSprite(x, y, spriteBytes, height), does NOT own framebuffer
- CPU reads input via input.isKeyPressed(key), does NOT own keypad state
- CPU sets buzzer via sound.setBuzzer(active), does NOT own audio context
- Memory loads ROMs via memory.loadRom(bytes), does NOT own file system
- Display renders via display.render(), does NOT own canvas context
- Timers update via timers.update(), do NOT own interval timing
- cpu MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- timers MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- Each component owns its own state. Other components access it ONLY through the public interface — never copy internal data.
- Use camelCase for all method names. No snake_case.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Can load and execute IBM logo ROM showing proper logo
- Can run CHIP-8 games like Pong, Space Invaders, Tetris
- All 35 opcodes pass test suite verification
- Display shows correct pixels with proper XOR behavior
- Sound plays when games use sound timer
- Input responds correctly to all 16 keys
- Timers decrement at exactly 60Hz rate
